ios.desc:
KickBack® Points
Earn. Enroll. Spend.

Stay on top of your KickBack Points with the KickBack Points app! This dynamic app for iPhone® and iPad® keeps track
of your transactions as well as the number of KickBack Points earned every time you make a purchase at a participating merchant. Plus, the handy KB locator enables you to find participating KickBack merchants across the country, along with information for each KickBack location.

Plot your next road trip. Plan your next purchase. Reward yourself with the KickBack Points app.

Features:
* Displays current points total
* Recent history of KickBack Points transactions
* KB locator
* Search by city, state, or zip
* Enroll your card
